images.title: Leveling — Sunbreak Basin
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original fantasy action-RPG environmental target artwork; an aspirational art-direction image, not a screenshot of an existing build.
Style/medium: cinematic, photorealistic-quality 3D fantasy rendering with believable real-world proportions and physically plausible lighting. Fine weathered materials, natural irregularity, grounded feet and contact shadows, hand-crafted composition. Mature and realistic, not cute or toy-like.
Composition/framing: one wide 16:9 image, elevated gameplay camera looking downward about 38–40 degrees with a rectilinear 45-degree field of view. See the characters' complete bodies and readable ground around them. Deep focus and clear silhouettes at gameplay scale, not an eye-level movie poster, not a miniature diorama. Keep the lower-right peripheral ground less busy where mobile controls would sit, but DRAW NO HUD, buttons, text, logos, borders or watermark.
Constraints: original designs only. No cartoon proportions, oversized heads, plastic materials, low-poly facets, tabletop plinths, spherical tree canopies, flat uniform grass carpet, excessive bloom, crushed-black shadows, blurry depth of field, quest markers, dialogue or loot panels.
Primary request: draw the realism target for persistent PvE LEVELING by mob grinding in an open collection of regions, not a linear road.
Scene/backdrop: Sunbreak Basin, a spacious sunlit temperate valley reclaiming a ruined frontier settlement. A clear irregular combat meadow occupies the middle ground; several broad walkable approaches open around natural low rock outcrops, mature branching trees and broken stone structures. Layered hillside and distant ruined watchtower give the area a cinematic sense of place. Ground has varied short grass, exposed earth, embedded stone, scattered leaves, roots and restrained small plants. Dense convincing foliage and weathered masonry concentrate at the clearing edges, never isolated on round pedestals. Landscape flows naturally into the distance; no straight cut-off boundary or single corridor.
Subject: one normal-proportioned adult mage in practical layered travel robes faces a small grinding pack consisting of an armored raider, a ranged frost caster and a larger rugged elite. Distinct full-body silhouettes and restrained readable spell accents; believable movement and anatomy, feet visible. The environment remains the main subject.
Lighting/mood: clear late-morning daylight, warm sunlight and soft cool skylight, leafy olive and forest greens with warm limestone and earthy browns. Bright enough to read all fighting surfaces, rich material detail and depth without a dark filter.
